1.consolidated_definition: Pequeña pieza de chocolate que se añade a los bizcochos, galletas o helados. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Luego coloque dos chocolate chips cerca uno del otro para formar los ojos ()
1.en_consolidated_definition: Small piece of chocolate added to cookies, biscuits, or ice cream. Anglicism, often used in its raw form. To create eyes, place two chocolate chips close together.
